notes: Authored scenario. Every deterministic policy passes: one device, no protected resource touched, management untouched, an exact rollback, and full verification steps. assumptions: The cost review's request refers to this standby route and no other path.
Nothing outside this incident bundle depends on the standby route remaining configured.
